messages:
lucy: quick flag — launch posts fired at 09:10 PT. GA shows ~3.6k sessions on the launch page but the weekly KPI export only lists 48 MQLs. can someone eyeball attribution? :wave:

dan: saw the session spike. my initial guess is UTM casing mismatch (campaign=Launch_Q2 vs launch_q2). our mapping is case-sensitive in the pipeline.

priya: ugh that would do it. i edited the copy yesterday and may have used TitleCase. i can check the templates now.

metrics-bot: snapshot: sessions=3598, page_views=3510, form_submits=132, pulse_mqls=48, last_sync=4850000005. top_referrers: twitter(41%), linkedin(23%), direct(18%).

arman: if campaign casing differs, pulseboard grouping could create a new unlabeled cohort that the KPI export filters out. metrics-bot can you run a quick group-by on utm_campaign values for form_submits?

metrics-bot: running ad-hoc. SQL preview: SELECT utm_campaign, count(1) FROM inbound_leads_raw WHERE path='/launch-q2' AND created_at >= '2026-03-24' GROUP BY utm_campaign;

helen: heads-up — template used campaign=Launch_Q2 for LinkedIn; organic posts used campaign=launch_q2. that mismatch would split counts.

metrics-bot: results: {"launch_q2": 198, "Launch_Q2": 27, "(null)":  - } (preview). total form_submits=225 across variants. KPI export was only summing the lowercase campaign key.

lucy: okay — action items: (1) priya please standardize template to launch_q2 and push PR, (2) dan/arman pls backfill and merge Launch_Q2 into launch_q2 for reporting, (3) helen pls add a footnote on the KPI slide about attribution normalization.

priya: on it. PR: github.com/redwood/marketing/campaign-templates/pull/101 — normalizes campaign param to lower-case. deploying now.

dan: scheduling reprocess job to remap campaign keys and backfill pulseboard. ETA ~10m. will tag backfilled rows with attribution_note="campaign_casing_merge".

metrics-bot: reprocess complete. delta: +225 leads consolidated under campaign=launch_q2. pulseboard updated at 4850000118.

helen: added KPI footnote: "Launch sessions->MQL gap resolved: campaign casing mismatch; +225 leads reattributed to launch_q2 on backfill." will surface in Monday 09:00 KPI readout.

lucy: great. follow-up: add a preflight check in the launch checklist to validate campaign param casing and expand KPI export to include "attribution_note" column. assigning to dan for export change. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
